mainEntity.name: What are the differences between vinyl, fiberglass, and wood windows for energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each material offers distinct benefits for energy efficiency. Vinyl windows are a popular, cost-effective choice known for good insulation properties and low maintenance. Fiberglass windows offer superior strength, durability, and excellent thermal performance due to their stability and resistance to expansion/contraction. Wood windows provide natural insulation and aesthetic appeal but require more maintenance. All three can be highly energy-efficient when manufactured with features like multiple panes and Low-E coatings, but fiberglass often leads in overall thermal performance and longevity.
